description: Rename a space, set its icon/colour/description, or move it into a sidebar group (#742 finding 04). Only the fields you pass change; pass null to clear colour, description, or group.

color.description: Palette colour: gray, brown, gold, orange, red, pink, purple, blue, teal, green, lime, cyan, indigo, magenta, rose. Omit on create and one is auto-assigned AT RANDOM, so databases created in a row can end up sharing a colour (two purples). Pass null to clear.

description.description: One line (max 200 chars) saying what this is FOR — read by list_* and describe_database, so it becomes context for whoever works here next. Set it when you create something: you already know the purpose at that moment. Pass null to clear.

group.description: Group name or id (from list_space_groups) to file this space under. Pass null to ungroup it.

icon.description: A curated icon ref, e.g. "set:rocket" or a brand/logo ref like "brand:github" (#298). See also: get_started section "ICONS" for the full catalog. A raw emoji (e.g. "📁") still works for backward compatibility with older data, but is not the preferred form.

restricted.description: Admin only. true = the space is visible only to people holding a grant on it (admins always see it); false = open again. A restricted database inside an open space is not opened by a space grant — it needs its own grant. Not allowed on personal spaces or system databases.
